trigger: The exact-moment destination scheme passes compiled moment constraints but both dynamic and constant-incoming controls fail the identical noise gate by step400. Thus macro enforcement alone is insufficient. The original mode23,2 has radius1.01403183, with a valid independent modal-map check.
reference: Wissocq,Gourdain,Malaspinas,Eyssartier2017, arXiv1701.07734v1, sections2 adaptation,3 stability: known-population preservation can be unstable; regularizedFD reconstructs stress from velocity gradients. This source is a numerical-method reference, not tunnel validation. Its all-population reconstruction and BGK collision differ from this trial.
candidate: Preserve the same destination macro targets and all known pulled populations. Replace the missing-population guess by factorized equilibrium at the target plus factorized covariance regularization with a finite-difference pre-collision stress. Project the missing set back onto the target mass, normal and tangent moment constraints. No fitted damping or collision change.
stress: S_ab=-rho_target*cs^2*[tau_s*(G_ab+G_ba-2/3*divu*delta_ab)+(2/3)*tau_bulk*divu*delta_ab], G_ab=d_a u_b at current destination, centered/second-order one-sided differences; tau_s=1/omega, tau_bulk=1 as actual unchanged collision. These incoming PDFs form the destination pre-collision state, so do not multiply this stress by1-omega.
projection: On a face normal correction is tied to mass and the known-population compatibility. At a corner the missing-set normal variance is16/121; beta=(delta_mn-vn*delta_rho)/(16/121), alpha=delta_rho-vn*beta; correction Wq*(alpha+beta*cn+delta_mt*ct/lambda_t+3*delta_mz*cz). Corner full-moment projection must be checked independently.
gates: Same symbolic and compiled2e-12 moment constraints, known-PDF edits0, same10000-step noise1.1 gate and same physical/acoustic/vortex gates. Do not claim the stability reported for published all-populationFD applies to this missing-population-only variant. If it fails, retain it as rejected and reconsider the full exterior boundary representation.
